rules.description: Verify total and per-capita GHG emission series share the same latest year.
Verify co-released CLRTAP/OECD air pollutant series (CO, NOX, SOX, VOC) share the same latest year.
Verify total and per-capita production-based CO2 emission series share the same latest year.
Verify all emission and CO2 productivity observations are non-negative.
Verify all 13 StatVars meet place/observation floors, non-negative bounds, and rolling freshness (>= max(2024, current_year - 4)) while allowing all future years.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, MinValue, NumPlaces, NumObservations, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs, SUM(NumObservations) OVER () AS total_obs FROM stats
params.condition: COALESCE(TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(TRIM(CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR)), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= GREATEST(2024, CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AS INTEGER) - 4), FALSE) AND total_svs >= 13 AND total_obs >= 35000 AND NumPlaces >= 50 AND NumObservations >= 1500 AND MinValue >= 0
